correctness.rationale: Every positive integer composition for each common richness and total through eight is generated, quotienting only joint species relabeling and exchange of the two communities. Exact rational comparison gives no strict reversal for totals at most seven and exactly one at total eight. Direct arithmetic verifies the two stated Bray–Curtis and Morisita–Horn values, and homogeneity proves the scaled recurrence.

value.rationale: Bray–Curtis and Morisita–Horn are established abundance-sensitive community similarity measures with documented differences in weighting. Fixing equal totals and requiring all species present isolates metric weighting from sample-size and turnover effects. The sharp minimum and unique first layer provide a natural interpretive and regression-test benchmark for a practically important metric-choice issue.
